mothers-day-sundance.comment: Not really a date idea, but good for mothers day

dates.name: Real Salt Lake vs. Portland Timbers FC — MLS Soccer
dates.desc: Major League Soccer matchup at America First Field. Real Salt Lake takes on Portland Timbers in a competitive mid-season clash. May is the perfect time for outdoor soccer with ideal weather. Pre-game parking and concessions available.
dates.where: America First Field — 9220 S State St, Sandy, UT 84070

dates.name: Sundance Mountain Resort — Spring Horseback Ride & Hiking Adventure
dates.desc: Spring is peak season at Sundance with aspen groves blooming and wildflower trails in full color. Guided horseback rides through scenic mountain terrain or challenge yourself with hiking to waterfalls and vistas. The Foundry Grill offers a celebrated Sunday brunch buffet (9 AM-2 PM) with farm-to-table ingredients.
dates.where: Sundance Mountain Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Mother's Day Celebration at Sundance — Brunch & Mountain Activities
dates.desc: Celebrate Mother's Day at Sundance with the famous Foundry Grill brunch (special Mother's Day menu with beloved favorites), followed by a scenic hike, horseback ride, or spa treatment. Spectacular mountain views and peaceful spring ambiance. Reservations highly recommended.
dates.where: Sundance Mountain Resort — 8841 Alpine Loop Rd, Sundance, UT 84604

dates.name: Pablo Cruise — Retro Rock Concert in Park City
dates.desc: Legendary soft rock band with three original members performing their greatest hits from the '70s and '80s. Intimate Park City venue with excellent acoustics. May concert run; perfect for a romantic evening in the mountains.
dates.where: Park City Live — Park City, UT (exact venue TBD; check visitparkcity.com)

dates.name: Real Salt Lake vs. Houston Dynamo — MLS Soccer
dates.desc: Real Salt Lake hosts Houston Dynamo in a mid-week MLS contest. Competitive soccer under the May evening lights at America First Field. This is one of RSL's final home games before the FIFA World Cup break.
dates.where: America First Field — 9220 S State St, Sandy, UT 84070

dates.name: Trappers Lake Trail — Little Cottonwood Canyon
dates.desc: Moderate 3.5-mile hike to a pristine alpine lake surrounded by wildflowers and mountain peaks. May is ideal for spring runoff views and blooming wildflowers. Less crowded than the famous Donut Falls, with equally stunning scenery. Great for photography.
dates.where: Trappers Lake Trailhead — Little Cottonwood Canyon Rd, UT (~25 miles from SLC)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Spring Wildlife & Wildflowers
dates.desc: May is peak season for island wildflowers blooming across sagebrush terrain. Roam the island by car or hike to see native bison herds, pronghorn, and bighorn sheep. Sunset views of the Great Salt Lake are spectacular. Pack a picnic.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075

dates.name: Snowbird Aerial Tram — High Alpine Scenic Experience
dates.desc: Ride the aerial tram 2,000 vertical feet to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for 360-degree views of the Wasatch Mountains, Lake Utah, and beyond. Accessible May through October. Walk the trails, visit the summit restaurant, or simply breathe the crisp alpine air. No skiing required — just stunning views.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — 9385 E Snowbird Tram Rd, Snowbird, UT 84092

dates.name: Dinner at Tupelo Park City — Globally-Inspired Fine Dining
dates.desc: Chef Matt Harris's celebrated farm-to-table restaurant showcasing artisanal ingredients: fresh Idaho trout, natural Utah lamb, heirloom grains, and housemade pasta. Sophisticated atmosphere with carefully curated wine pairings. Reservations essential.
dates.where: Tupelo Park City — 1375 Park Ave, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: Park City Historic Main Street — Explore & Dine
dates.desc: Walkable historic district lined with local restaurants, galleries, and shops. Grab coffee at a local café, browse art galleries, and choose from diverse dining options (pizza, sushi, burgers, fine dining). Live music often plays on weekends. Perfect for a relaxed spring afternoon.
dates.where: Park City Historic Main Street — Park City, UT (various restaurants/galleries)

dates.name: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway — High Alpine Drive & Hiking
dates.desc: Utah's highest paved road at 10,715 feet (Bald Mountain Pass). 42-mile scenic drive with multiple pullouts, photo ops, and short hikes. Opens late May typically. Stunning panoramic views, mountain wildflowers, and pristine alpine lakes. Bring layers — it's cool at elevation.
dates.where: Mirror Lake Scenic Byway — State Route 150, Kamas to Duck Creek (1 hour from Park City)

dates.name: TopGolf at Vineyard — Gamified Golf Experience
dates.desc: Gamified golf bays with automatic scoring, full food menu, and zero golf skill required. Fun, competitive energy with lively bar scene. Bay pricing is per bay, not per person — great value for two. Play games, grab food, enjoy the vibe.
dates.where: TopGolf — 484 N Entertainment Way, Vineyard, UT 84059

dates.name: Riverdance — The Show at Eccles Theater
dates.desc: The legendary Irish dance and music spectacular — thunderous footsteps, live orchestral score, and mesmerizing choreography. Runs May 22-24, 2026. One of the most beloved touring shows. You loved The Phantom of the Opera; Riverdance offers equally breathtaking performance artistry.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Clark Planetarium + The Gateway District Stroll
dates.desc: Free interactive science museum with immersive space exhibits and full-dome IMAX theater. Then stroll The Gateway district for dessert, shopping, art installations, or an arcade bar. Easy afternoon with lots of options.
dates.where: Clark Planetarium — 110 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Themed Cook-Off Challenge at Home
dates.desc: Pick a cuisine neither of you has cooked before — Japanese, Moroccan, Thai, Korean, Vietnamese, Lebanese — grab ingredients together, then challenge yourselves to make a full meal from scratch. Set timers, taste-test, laugh at mistakes, and enjoy the result. Competitive and creative.

dates.name: Board Game Tournament Night at Home
dates.price: Free (if you own games) or $0 - $20 (new game purchase)
dates.desc: Pick 2-3 board games you've never played together. Set a tournament bracket, keep score across games, and crown an ultimate champion. Grab snacks, make it competitive, and celebrate victory. Silly, fun, and surprisingly engaging.

dates.name: Escape Room at Getout Games — Salt Lake City
dates.desc: Four themed rooms downtown: Egyptian Tomb, Zombie on a Chain, The Heist, or Reactor Room. 60 minutes of puzzle-solving and teamwork under pressure. Book in advance; evening slots available daily. Great for testing your problem-solving chemistry.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Indoor Rock Climbing at Red Rock Climbing Center
dates.desc: Beginner-friendly climbing gym in Salt Lake with hundreds of routes at all difficulty levels. No experience needed — staff teaches you everything. It's active, fun, slightly competitive, and feels like a real achievement (even on easy walls). Great date energy.
dates.where: Red Rock Climbing Center — 2074 E Fort Union Blvd, Salt Lake City, UT 84121
